_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: UOM-<recordNo>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mdm_site.name

name.description: Name of the unit of measure; used as its display value in other collections

scope.description: Whether the record applies to the whole enterprise or to one site

symbol.description: Symbol of the unit of measure

dimension.description: Dimension of the unit of measure

baseUnitOfMeasureId.description: Reference to u_mes_mdm_unitOfMeasure._id: base unit of measure

baseUnitOfMeasureName.description: Display value of baseUnitOfMeasureId, copied from u_mes_mdm_unitOfMeasure.name

factorToBase.description: Multiplier to convert to the base unit of the dimension

isBaseUnit.description: True when the record is base unit

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1
